customManagers.description: ECR pull-through cache: prepend the ECR prefix to registry-qualified images (public.ecr.aws / registry.k8s.io / quay.io and docker.io/<namespace>/<image>), keeping the upstream path. Versions and digests are looked up upstream.

ECR pull-through cache: prepend the ECR prefix to Docker Hub official images, injecting docker.io/library/. Matches explicitly-qualified official images (docker.io/<image>) and bare official images (<image>).
ECR pull-through cache: prepend the ECR prefix to bare Docker Hub namespaced images (<namespace>/<image>), injecting docker.io/.

packageRules.description: The custom regex managers rewrite these images to the ECR pull-through prefix. Disable the built-in dockerfile manager for them so it doesn't create duplicate, conflicting updates that fail autoreplace. This allowlist matches the registry-qualified targets (public.ecr.aws / registry.k8s.io / quay.io / docker.io) plus bare Docker Hub images (official '<image>' and namespaced '<namespace>/<image>', i.e. a first path segment with no '.' or ':'). Everything else (e.g. gcr.io, already-ECR-prefixed images) is left to the dockerfile manager.
